codeDecisions.forkBehavior: Tracks unique automatic Web session identities in a sliding time window, blocks new sessions at the configured limit, preserves already active or already counted sessions, and distinguishes local duration pause from provider rate-limit drain and account-security hard stop.
codeDecisions.localGap: NEKODEX has strong per-account pacing, maximum concurrency, breaks, session duration and cooldowns, but does not count unique new Web conversations in a rolling window.

localFiles.note: Existing per-account policy and persisted safety state.

codeDecisions.recommendedBoundedFix: Adapt only the sliding unique-session window into the existing per-account AccountSafety. Count a stable new Web conversation identity, allow already-counted and active work to finish, block only creation of an uncounted session, never select another account because of the limit, and expose remaining/reset time in the existing pacing UI. Do not import Evan's TypeScript runtime or launcher settings wholesale.
